event: HPAI H5N1 first wave in Vietnam
magnitude: About 45 million poultry culled or died; direct loss about 0.1 percentage points of GDP
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Poultry supply loss; culling; trade bans
frequency_trend: H5N1 now endemic in poultry; clade 2.3.4.4b spreading to mammals worldwide since 2021 to 2024
notes: World Bank 2005 figure cited in a conference paper; primary not read.

magnitude: Death and culling of about 40% of China's pig population (as cited)
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Regional pork price spike; lower Chinese soymeal demand; pig smuggling pressure on Vietnam
frequency_trend: ASF endemic across Asia
notes: Figure is a citation inside GEO-14.

magnitude: Nearly 6 million pigs died or culled (over 20% of herd); 8,553 of 10,614 communes affected; pig prices +45% (traditional), +14% (commercial), +11% (modern); pig trade volume halved; USDA (MARD data): over 5.9 million pigs culled by Dec 2019 (about 23% of herd), live-weight pig output down 13.8%, pork supplied in Q1 2020 down 19.3% y/y; poultry output up 16.5% in 2019
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Pork supply loss; feed demand drop; consolidation towards large farms; in protein terms a pork shock, not a national shortfall: pork share of meat output 71.5% to 65.6%, consumers switched to chicken, about 100,000 t of pork imports ordered for Q1 2020
frequency_trend: Epidemic 2019 to 2020, endemic from 2021
source_ids: GEO-14; GEO-15; MAC-37; PAN-03; PAN-04; PAN-36
notes: Live pig prices collapsed to VND 24,000 to 35,000 per kg in May 2019 (PAN-04, press) and reached a record above VND 90,000 per kg in late Dec 2019 (PAN-03). Second commune count: 8,509 of 11,055 (77%) (PAN-36; DG-353). Model (GEO-14): a 10% fall in pig output costs 0.36% of GDP (USD 0.88 billion, 2018 base) and about 247,000 jobs; the actual fall (13.8%) lies between the 10% and 25% scenarios. Household tofu use flat 2018 to 2020 (DIE-05).

magnitude: 3,029 outbreaks in 59 of 63 provinces
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Herd loss; smallholder exit
frequency_trend: Endemic; outbreaks 952 (2023) to 1,669 (2024)

event: Recombinant genotype I/II ASF virus spreads
magnitude: Share of outbreaks 14.1% to 42.2% in northern and central Vietnam (2023 to 2024); in 2025, 79% of typed samples in the north (158 of 200), 76% in the centre and Central Highlands (32 of 42), 60% in the south (6 of 10); resistant to commercial vaccines
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Vaccine failure risk; renewed herd losses; pork supply and price swings
frequency_trend: Rising; dominant in typed samples in the north and centre by 2025
notes: 2025 shares and vaccine scope from MAE official letter 2481/CNTY-DT (12 Sep 2025), read in full (PAN-33, High): the three licensed vaccines are made from genotype II virus and have no protective effect against other genotypes. The 2023 to 2024 shares are of positive samples, the 2025 shares of typed surveillance samples. Signpost of a recombinant share above 50% crossed in 2025.

magnitude: About 1.2 million pigs culled in 2025 (about 3.8% of the end-2025 herd, our calculation); 636 outbreaks in over 28 of 34 provinces by 22 Jul 2025
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Pork supply and feed demand dip; culling sales caused local oversupply and live hog prices fell to about VND 50,000 per kg in Nov 2025, recovering by Tet 2026; consumers shifted to chicken
frequency_trend: Recurring every 2 to 3 years since 2019
notes: Over 330,000 pigs culled by about 21 Aug 2025 and about 7.8 million vaccine doses supplied, with a low vaccination rate (PAN-06); the jump from about 43,000 (22 Jul, PAN-05) may reflect different counting. Escape from the vaccines without a 2019-scale die-off so far.

frequency_trend: Recurring; managed trade

magnitude: Antibiotics only for diagnosed disease
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Higher disease-management cost; biosecurity investment; possible short-run productivity dip

event: Consumer pork price rise after African swine fever
magnitude: Pork CPI item +57.23% on 2019 (1.94 points of a 3.23% CPI rise); foods +12.28%; processed meat +21.59%; lard +58.99%
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Price of the main meat for households; protein budgets
frequency_trend: Largest protein-food price shock for consumers since 2008; from domestic disease, not imported inputs
notes: NSO 2020 price release read through a summarising fetch tool; agrees with press reports. Compare SHK-010 (2022: pork -10.68%).

event: World food and commodity price spike; high domestic inflation
magnitude: CPI +22.97% on 2007; staple foods more than 49%; other foods (including meat and fish) more than 32%
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: All food prices, staples first
frequency_trend: Export restrictions recur in each price crisis (see SHK-010)
notes: Press report citing GSO (now NSO); the GSO release was not reachable. No meat breakdown.

event: Highly pathogenic avian influenza in poultry
magnitude: 80 outbreaks in 73 communes of 17 provinces; over 349,400 birds dead or culled (about 0.06% of the end-2025 flock of 584.9 million, our calculation); first-round vaccination covered 51.44% of required birds
impact_channel_on_protein_supply: Local poultry losses; no national supply effect found
frequency_trend: Recurring; Decision 779/QD-TTg targets 30% fewer outbreaks than the 2019 to 2025 average by 2030
notes: No human H5N1 case in Viet Nam in 2026 to 6 Sep (PAN-01). Press report citing the Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health.
